## Introduction

An AI agent is a software system that can work toward a goal by choosing and carrying out a sequence of actions.

Unlike a basic chatbot that responds to one prompt at a time, an agent may:

- interpret a task;
- decide what steps are needed;
- use available tools;
- review the result;
- continue until the task is completed.

## A Simple Example

Imagine asking an AI system to prepare a short overview of recent developments in renewable energy.

A standard chatbot may provide an answer based on a single prompt.

An AI agent could follow a broader workflow:

```text
Understand the request
        ↓
Search for relevant information
        ↓
Organize the findings
        ↓
Check the result
        ↓
Prepare the final overview
